reviewer: Anthropic, fresh-context subagent (Agent tool, model opus = claude-opus-5-5); claude -p unavailable: OAuth session expired

findings.claim: Rule 3/job use only payments.refund_status IS NULL; partial and non-app refunds are never written to payments, so a partially refunded payment would be paid out in full; refund-after-payout of that kind is never flagged.
findings.evidence: lib/payments/webhook.mjs:127-130 charge.refunded with amount_refunded != amount_minor only logs and returns ignored; webhook.mjs:176-180 refund.updated/failed failing isOurFullRefund ignored. Brief: any refund row, full or partial, never owed.
findings.fix: Record any partial/external refund via additive column or check refunds.list under claim; DB tests partial dashboard refund before/after transfer.

findings.claim: New idempotency key per attempt including re-claim after lease expiry can create two Stripe transfers; no Stripe-side cap like refunds; DB unique keys do not prevent a second Stripe transfer.
findings.evidence: Spec step 4 reclaims transferring with expired lease and increments attempts -> new key; stalled worker A + worker B both create. refunds.mjs:15-16 relies on Stripe refusing refund over amount; transfers have no such guard.
findings.fix: Bump key suffix only after definitive (not-executed) errors; reuse key after timeout/5xx/lease expiry; lease longer than SDK timeout*retries; fix 'hard guarantee' wording; test overlapping attempts -> one create.

findings.claim: SQL integer share computation overflows int4 for allowed prices.
findings.fix: Use amount_minor::bigint * commission_bps / 10000; tests at 500000 grosze, 9999 and 10000 bps; SQL equals JS.

findings.claim: Without source_transaction, transfers fail balance_insufficient for days; 5 attempts over ~81 min exhausted, so nearly every payout ends manual.
findings.evidence: OQ5 + backoff 1,5,15,60 with max 5. Charge id reachable via PaymentIntent latest_charge.
findings.fix: Use source_transaction = latest_charge, or do not count balance_insufficient toward the limit; test.

findings.claim: Payout that loses lease on attempt 5 stays transferring forever and is not counted in health.
findings.evidence: Claim predicate requires attempts < 5; health counts only failed.

findings.claim: Dual-secret verification placed in stripe-client/route but secret chosen in handleStripeWebhook.
findings.fix: Change handleStripeWebhook; tests for connect-signed accepted, wrong secret 400.

findings.claim: Concurrent accounts.create with same key gets 409, not same account; keys expire after 24h -> orphan accounts.
findings.evidence: Stripe saves no idempotent result for a conflicting in-flight request.
findings.fix: Lock mentor row before Stripe call; treat idempotency conflict as retryable.

findings.claim: DS mapping omits cancelled; summary does not say held total includes owed-but-unrecorded requests.
findings.evidence: Spec line 69 five statuses, line 100 maps four; draft MentorPayouts.tsx:27.
findings.fix: Define cancelled display; held computed from owed requests (rule 3) not only payouts rows.

findings.claim: /mentor/payouts renders a payouts page before first paid request, brief says nothing mentions payouts.
